description: Liquidity s5-v11: a sweep carries the §4.4 class its level had on the candle the sweep confirmed. Each mutation brings back a way the class could be decided with knowledge that candle did not have. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/liquidity_sweep_class.json

mutations.name: a sweep copies the pool row's window-end class (single- and two-candle sweeps share this call since s5-v13)
with no bracket yet, the sweep takes the row's current class instead of its birth class
a swing still inside its confirmation window brackets the sweep
